# crosswork_data_gateway_pools (Resource)

This resource can manage a pool of Crosswork Data Gateway instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_data_gateway_pools" "example" {
  name                  = "cwtest-gen-pool"
  description           = "Pool of the production gateways"
  virtual_ips           = ["172.16.34.198"]
  prefix_length         = 24
  spares                = 0
  instances             = ["2d009d08-e1eb-46b8-a137-1ef15e20ec72"]
  cdg_readiness_timeout = 60
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instances` (List of String) Ids of the data gateway instances of the pool, as `crosswork_data_gateway_instances` lists them; the first one becomes the active instance of the first data gateway
- `name` (String) Pool name, made of letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the virtual IP addresses, 1 to 32 for IPv4 and 1 to 128 for IPv6
  - Range: `1`-`128`
- `virtual_ips` (List of String) Virtual IP addresses of the pool, all IPv4 or all IPv6, one for each active instance; each one is the address of one data gateway in the order of this list

### Optional

- `cdg_readiness_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for the controller to accept a change of the pool and for its data gateways to appear; it only limits how long Terraform waits and is not part of the Crosswork configuration
  - Range: `30`-`1800`
  - Default value: `60`
- `description` (String) Description of the pool
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `spares` (Number) Number of spare instances of the pool
  - Default value: `0`

### Read-Only

- `data_gateway_ids` (List of String) Ids of the data gateways of the pool, in the order of the virtual IPs
- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_data_gateway_pools.example "<id>"
```
